head: 8467f01
summary: Second confirmation round, on 8467f01. git diff --stat 1430d42 8467f01 -- cabin777/src shows only 04_shaders.js (+82/-?), 12_scene.js and 07_shell.js (4 lines) changed. 10_mono.js and 05_layout.js are untouched, so the monument geometry, materials and atlas are byte-identical to the 1430d42 build I rated 8.8. In my own old_r vs new diff, the share of pixels with |dL|>8 is 0.00 % in q01, q11, q19, m01, m03, m06, m09 and m12, 0.10 % in m05, 0.21 % in q13 and 1.86 % in m02 (window belt only). The share with |d(B-R)|>8 is 0.0-0.4 % for the bar, welcome galley, door-1 galley and door 1. The big hue shifts are q19 22.7 %, m12 25.1 % and m09 11.2 %, which is the routed galley lavender being removed, plus q13 22.2 % (PY seat fabric, B-R about -10) and m02 4.2 % (left window wall, x<460). Re-measured, the bar elements match the last round exactly: the cabinet pane p10/50/90 is 37/42/69, the ovens p50 137, the control panel 136/140/143, the nosing 215/217/236, the right bay L3 and the counter p50 27. Rated afresh, geometry first, the bar still has the in-service face layout and order (omaat_j32). The welcome galley, the F front wall with its ink print and drapes, door 1, the lavs and the door-4/5 galleys are unchanged in geometry and proportion. The one medium on the monuments was a lighting item, and it is now fixed, so the galley whites read as a single neutral face. That is not scored, but it removes the main distraction in q19, m12 and m09. The remaining differences are the same carried lows: the flat white nosing, the cabinet reading as open shelving, the flat control panel, the crushed right bay, the black soffit and cheeks over the bar, and the w18-w21 detail lows. Score 8.8, unchanged. There are no high or medium issues.
lighting_note: Not scored. (1) FIXED: the L14 seat-level cool light / bleed no longer reaches the door-4 and door-5 galleys. White-pixel B-R (L>140), lower band at 60-85 % of frame height against the upper band at 20-45 %, on 1430d42 -> 8467f01: q19 +7.1/-3.6 -> -4.6/-3.6, m12 +7.5/-6.2 -> -5.0/-6.2, m09 +5.3/-6.6 -> -2.6/-6.6. q19 and m12 meet the target (within 3, about -3 to -5). m09 is 4.0 apart, just outside the 3 target, but the lower band is now the warmer one (-2.6, neutral) and the visual split at 1.3 m is gone. The q19 column profile of rows 100-575 runs +0.4 to -8.4 with no step at the counter line; rows 500-575 at about -8 are the cart and floor faces. (2) Carried: the m05 right open bay is crushed to L3 (j32 about L11), the counter shows no local reflections, and the soffit over the bar is black where j32 shows a pale lit panel. (3) Door 1, the bar, the welcome galley and the F wall show no lighting change on monument surfaces (door-1 lining in q01: L p50 213 both, B-R +0.3 -> -0.4).
